blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Suspected drug lord Samuel “Sammy” Uy was among the payees of manager’s checks presented during Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Wednesday. The House prosecution panel bared this during the 35th day of the trial, when it presented manager’s checks supposedly sourced from a Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) account
